text:
mia: quick sync — catalog launch targeted next Tue. need clear owners + licensing signoff for three incoming open models: zephyr-7b, alder-9b, navis-7b. perf profiles mostly scaffolded but alder has tail latency on long contexts, navis embeddings mismatch in staging. any blockers or infra deps we should call out?

sam: i'll own product coordination and zephyr launch comms. @lee can you take perf signoff for zephyr?

lee: i can own zephyr perf. zephyr looks stable in my runs (median ~28ms for typical 2k seqs on ded 8xA100); i'll push the perf profile to the catalog repo by EOD. alder — i'm seeing 95th latency spikes for >8k; likely kv-cache sharding + batching mismatch. opening a perf ticket now.

julian: noted on alder. infra currently schedules smaller batch sizes for that model flavor. i'll check the batcher config and kernel selection. FYI alder private build needs CUDA12 image (we haven't pushed that to private registry yet) — infra dep to resolve.

ana: (note: typo — should be ana)

ana: (ignore)

ana: sorry accidental message

ana: (removing)

ana: (removing again)

ana: whoops — glitch

ana: (final)

ana: legal: quick update — zephyr: apache2 ok. alder: dependency with non-commercial clause in submodule, need to confirm upstream patch or replacement; please paste repo link so we can triage. navis: licensing ok but we need an embeddings retention addendum for customers. i'll review and flag items in the checklist by Thu EOD.

lee: opened GH issue #4821 with perf traces + config snippets. excerpt:
```
trace_id: trace-20240321-7f8c
cmd: ./run_perf --model alder-9b --seq 8192 --bs 1 --profile > /tmp/alder-trace.log
```
linking logs: https://logs.internal/redwood/alder/trace-20240321-7f8c

mia: owners so far: sam (PO), lee (zephyr + alder perf), julian (infra), ana (legal). still need owner for navis embeddings shape changes — @nora any capacity?

nora: i can take navis. saw staging: embeddings dim=1536 but catalog expects 1024. i'll run conversion/migration and update metadata. ETA tomorrow morning.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: zephyr-7b.variant-a on dedicated — canary_id: canary-1719999 — runs tomorrow 03:30 UTC. :shipit:

sam: rollout gating checklist: perf pass (lee), infra + capacity confirmation (julian), legal signoff (ana for alder), navis embedding fix (nora). if all green, we can proceed with controlled rollout. escalate any blocker by Fri morning.

mia: i've updated the tracking doc and milestone: https://docs.internal/redwood/catalog/onboard-1719999 and LIN-12345 in Linear. please add links to any GH issues or logs in that doc. freeze manifests by Fri EOD.

lee: one ask — can someone run 5 long-context runs for alder at 32k tokens (to capture tail behavior)? i need stable runs to compare kernel changes.

julian: yes — i can reserve 1xA100 for 3 hours Thu morning. ping me exact time and i'll allocate.

nora: migration command i'm planning to run:
```
python tools/convert_embeddings.py --input s3://staging/navis --out s3://catalog/navis --dim 1024 --verify
```
will post results to the doc.

ana: (final legal note) i've added the alder dependency to the legal checklist and marked it waiting. will escalate if the upstream doesn't accept license change.

mia: thanks all — i'll compile a short rollout checklist and ping product + legal tomorrow AM. :thumbsup:
